recommendation_summary: Keep the shared folder for drafting only. Add a controlled release step now: a reviewer other than the author approves through an individually authenticated account, and each release stores the exact approved file, the approver identity and the approval time in a separate archive. Authors cannot alter that archive, and retention controls keep it for seven years. Later edits need a new approval. The APPROVED column can stay as a status indicator only. The reply says the protections still need to be checked before shipping. It names no specific tool or configuration.
note: The reply turns down the initials and naming-convention plan and chooses a controlled release archive that has every LARGER capability, but none of the four required record labels appear.
